paragraphs.text: Lizard is a creature type used for any land-based reptiles with limbs and external ears ( snakes lack both these characteristics).
Sentient, anthropomorphic lizard folk are found on several planes . These lizard folk can go by different names such as lizardfolk or viashino .
Lizards appear predominantly red and green . However, they've appeared in blue and black as well.
The first creature to bear the type was Leaping Lizard in Homelands .

Although humanoid, Rampart Crawler ( Mercadian Masques ), Lizard Warrior ( Portal ), Hall Monitor ( Strixhaven: School of Mages ), and Ignacio of Myra's Marvels ( Unfinity ) were printed as lizards instead of viashino . The lizardfolk in Dungeons & Dragons sets - Scaled Herbalist ( Adventures in the Forgotten Realms ), Underdark Explorer ( Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate ), and Lizardfolk Librarians ( Alchemy Horizons: Baldur's Gate ) - were similarly printed as lizards.
Outlaws of Thunder Junction introduced Laughing Jasper Flint and Hellspur Posse Boss the first vaishino printed with the lizard type.
Bloomburrow included lizard typal . As Bloomburrow's lizardfolk are not native to Valley , the are based on species not native to the Eastern United States .

During the Grand Creature Type Update , the dinosaur subtype was dropped, and most dinosaurs had their type changed to lizard. As such, Pygmy Allosaurus in Ice Age retroactively became the first lizard. However, the Ixalan block reintroduced dinosaurs as a separate creature type, and many prior dinosaurs were turned back.
Rampart Crawler also gained the subtype lizard solely based on its artwork.
The related humanoid race of Viashino was given errata to be lizards with the release of Modern Horizons 3 . The vaishino update came just before Bloomburrow .

Lizards can be found on many planes, including Alara , Arcavios , Amonkhet , Avishkar , Dominaria , Ikoria , Ixalan , Tarkir , and Zendikar . Humanoid lizardfolk (including viashino) can be found on Alara , Arcavios Bloomburrow , Capenna , Dominaria , Gastal , Karsus , and Ravnica .
Alaran viashino dwelled on the shard of Jund .
The viashino thrashes also kept iguanars ( Hissing Iguanar ) as hunting companions, giving them wounded captives as playthings.
The spiky thrinaxes (named after a type of prehistoric Earth therapsids. ) have responded to Jund's ferocious food chains by adapting to reproduce by being eaten.
Lizardfolk such as Hall Monitor and Inspired Skypainter can be found on Arcavios.
Lizards or lizardfolk are one of the animalfolk native to Bloomburrow . While not originally native to the Valley , they are now one of the more common animalfolk there.

Lizardfolk are known for their fire magic. The lizardfolk are a culture of expressive artists, encouraging artistic expression from a young age, primarily through metalwork, but also with fabrics and paints. They know that art is meant to inspire awe and wonder. They value creation and destruction in equal measure. As soon as they feel bored by their art, they will destroy it and use the pieces to create something new.

Lizardfolk are at their element when thick in the fray as either fiery shamans or sneaky assassins. Lizardfolk also find work as blacksmiths and artisans, passing those skills down to other animalfolk. At their best, lizardfolk are passionate, resilient, and direct. At their worst, lizardfolk are moody, aggressive, and cruel.
Many seasons before the Omenpath Era , lizardfolk populated Valley's few shaley hills and rocky ravines, which best resemble the habitats of their homelands.

Lizards have a spiritual attachment to fire. As cold-blooded creatures, they rely on the heat of flame when sunbathing is not an option. Every lizardfolk community has a central ﬁre source, whether it is a village hearth, a mystical ember, or a forge. Rituals, like dancing, singing, or just basking in front of their community furnace or the one in their home, are part of everyday lizardfolk spiritual life. They worship the Ever-Burning Oak , considering it a symbol of the cycle of creation and destruction. Young lizardfolk journey to the tree, collecting a smoldering ember from its center with their bare hands. Blacksmiths use these embers to fuel their forges, and assassins keep their embers with them in uniquely crafted ceramic, metal, or glass containers. Though the heat eventually fades, an ember's powerful magic lasts nearly a lizardfolk's whole life; when their ember goes out, a lizardfolk knows they will die soon. They are also known to make pilgrimages to the Forest of Iron. Lizardfolk magic typically revolves around the use of ﬁre. Some lizardfolk arts even allow them to channel venom into their flames.
One of their kin, Gev , assisted Mabel in her quest to stop the Calamity Beasts .
Capennan viashino are more draconic than lizard-like, to the point of some possessing breath weapons. They are found almost exclusively among the Riveteers family.
Dominarian viashino are thought to be created by Terrent Amese . . The main viashino civilization is in Shiv . However, they can also be found in the Burning Isles , Jamuraa , and Tamingazin .

Rootwallas , lizards with orange bodies, tails, and blue heads and legs, resemble real-life chuckwallas. Many specimens, but not all, possess neck frills similar to those of real-life frill-necked lizards. Some are covered in armored plates. Following the Rathi Overlay , rootwallas were encountered in Dominaria during the Mirari crisis and the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria .

Ravnican viashino can be found throughout society, whether among the general guildless population, or as members of one of Ravnica's Guilds. Guild-affiliated viashino are most often found within the Boros Legion , Gruul Clans , and Izzet League .
The Simic Combine has used lizards in many of its experiments ( 7 cards ).
In the Undercity , the Golgari Swarm devkarin keep monitor lizards as pack animals and crocodiles as hunting companions.

Leapers are giant, mud-colored lizards on Ulgrotha that can jump many feet into the air. They are generally dumb but smart enough to catch vermin to eat and dig holes in winter. Some in An-Havva believe that they were once humans , transformed into lizards by Autumn Willow .

A large lizard species known as the lagac has developed from the earliest forms of life on Zendikar and withstood both the Eldrazi invasion and the rise of the civilized races. They are large red- or green-scaled lizards with tusks, spines, and beady eyes. Some are used as mounts, while others can breathe fire.
